What Happens After You Contact Us?

We know that planning a construction project can feel overwhelming. Our goal is to make the process simple, transparent, and stress-free from your first call through project completion.

1. Tell Us About Your Project

Contact us by phone, email, or through the contact form. Let us know what type of project you're planning, where it's located, and any questions you may have.

2. Schedule a Consultation

We'll review your project, discuss your goals, and arrange a convenient time to evaluate the property if needed. Every project is different, and we take the time to understand your specific needs.

3. Receive a Detailed Estimate

We'll provide a clear estimate outlining the scope of work and answer any questions so you can make an informed decision before moving forward.

4. Begin Your Project

Once you're ready, our experienced team schedules your project and keeps you informed throughout every phase of construction. We focus on quality workmanship, dependable communication, and completing every project to the highest standards.

Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions before contacting us? Here are answers to some of the questions we receive most often. If you don't see your question below, feel free to call or complete our contact form. We're always happy to help.

Do you provide free estimates?

Yes. We provide free consultations and estimates for residential and commercial projects throughout Massachusetts. We'll discuss your project, answer your questions, and recommend the best solution for your property.

What types of projects do you work on?

We specialize in masonry and hardscapes, asphalt paving, excavation and site development, drainage solutions, retaining walls, outdoor living spaces, and commercial snow and ice management.

What areas do you serve?

We proudly serve homeowners, businesses, municipalities, and property managers throughout Greater Boston, Central Massachusetts, and many surrounding communities. Visit our Service Areas page for more information.

How quickly will someone respond to my inquiry?

We make every effort to respond to all inquiries within one business day. If your request is urgent, we recommend calling our office during normal business hours.

Can I request an estimate online?

Absolutely. Complete the contact form with as much information as possible about your project, and a member of our team will contact you to discuss the next steps.

Do you work with both residential and commercial clients?

Yes. Our team completes projects for homeowners, commercial property owners, property managers, municipalities, and general contractors throughout Massachusetts.

What information should I include when contacting you?

Please include your location, the type of project you're planning, an estimated timeline, and any details that will help us understand your goals. Photos are also helpful when available.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. S. Phaneuf & Associates is fully licensed and insured, giving our customers confidence that every project is completed professionally and responsibly.

Can you help if I'm not sure exactly what I need?

Of course. Many clients contact us during the planning stage. We'll discuss your ideas, explain your options, and help you determine the best solution based on your property, budget, and long-term goals.

How do I get started?

Simply call us or complete the contact form on this page. We'll schedule a consultation, review your project, and provide a detailed estimate so you can move forward with confidence.

Services You Can Contact Us About

Whether you're planning a residential improvement, commercial development, or municipal project, S. Phaneuf & Associates provides complete masonry, asphalt paving, excavation, site development, and snow management services throughout Massachusetts. Explore our services below or contact us to discuss your project.

Masonry & Hardscapes

Custom patios, retaining walls, walkways, outdoor kitchens, fireplaces, fire pits, pool decks, stone veneer, entryways, and complete outdoor living spaces designed to enhance the beauty and functionality of your property.

Asphalt Paving

Residential driveways, commercial parking lots, roadway paving, asphalt resurfacing, repairs, and long-lasting paving solutions completed with proper site preparation and quality workmanship.

Excavation & Site Development

Site preparation, grading, drainage improvements, foundation excavation, utility installation, land clearing, and complete site development services for residential and commercial projects.

Snow & Ice Management

Commercial snow plowing, parking lot clearing, sidewalk snow removal, ice management, snow hauling, and dependable winter maintenance services that help keep properties safe and accessible.
